# ENUMERATED

## Syntax

```synesis
FIELD <name> TYPE ENUMERATED
    SCOPE <scope>
    VALUES ... END VALUES
    [DESCRIPTION <text>]
    [GUIDELINES ... END GUIDELINES]
    [CONTEXT FROM DATASET <section>]
END FIELD
```

`[ ]` optional · `<>` value to replace

## Example

```synesis
FIELD example_enumerated TYPE ENUMERATED
    SCOPE ITEM
    VALUES
        low: low intensity
        high: high intensity
    END VALUES
END FIELD
```

## Value in the annotation

The value written is the **label** declared in `VALUES`:

```synesis
zone: Method
```

Unlike `ORDERED`, there is no index: `ENUMERATED` has no order, so the `[N]` prefix in the `VALUES` block is refused with `SYNESIS_E087`.

## Properties

| Property | Status | Error if violated |
|---|---|---|
| `CONTEXT FROM DATASET` | Allowed | - |
| `DESCRIPTION` | Allowed | - |
| `GUIDELINES` | Allowed | - |
| `ARITY` | Forbidden | SYNESIS_E055 |
| `FORMAT` | Forbidden | SYNESIS_E054 |
| `RELATIONS` | Forbidden | SYNESIS_E056 |
| `VALUES` | Required | SYNESIS_E050 |
